caseName: Moore v. Payless Shoe Source, Inc.
caseNameFull: Moore v. Payless Shoe Source, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed informa pau-peris granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Cleveland v. Policy Management Systems Corp., ante, p. 795.
